geometry_bands.source_anchor: dash-to-target movement attack: Rake moves the character to the target position on cast (dash-slash) and applies an aggravated Bleed stack at the destination ('building as much Bleeding... before dashing away'). Mirrors PoE1-flicker (queried: geometry_value=dash_attack -- teleport/dash-strike lands the hit in one action). DIFFERENCE noted: flicker auto-chains target-to-target on Frenzy Charges; Rake is a SINGLE controlled dash-in / dash-out BLEED-BUILDER (dash in, apply bleed, Disengage out, repeat) -- a builder cadence, not an auto-chaining engine. Physical melee -> element-neutral (physical rule). aggravated Bleed -> bleed (variant magnitude in param_ranges, no new ailment) per Section-A.

when bleed accumulation is sufficient, Blood Hunt is the single-target burst execution spending the banked bleed ('followed by Blood Hunt'). Point-contact finisher -> melee_strike. Secondary spend-stage per 7.2; the every-3-seconds loop is the Rake dash-bleed-builder.
